fieldValues.title: Real use: the first essay, a client contract (2026-10-21)
fieldValues.chose: The owner built a client contract as an essay: the source documents went in first, then a structured, cross-referenced text was written against them. What worked: an attached source per document and evidences links from sources to paragraphs, the backbone a stable shared package should keep. What broke: the editor recorded no author for the owner's own text (srs-web#618); agents wrote more than the text, which the owner manages by editing and re-editing toward human text without bloat; the conversation with Claude and ChatGPT happened in their own chats, so the essay holds none of it; and the argument package carries more than the essay used, so simplifying it is valuable. A structural copy of the essay, every value replaced and leak-checked, is kept outside the repositories until the owner chooses where it lives.
fieldValues.rationale: Remedy c21da256: a real user's session is an occasion; it is reported, its findings enter intake, and its file is kept.
fieldValues.figures: 20 paragraphs (1,600 words, median 75; 19 edited after creation), 8 sources each with one attached document, 20 evidences links (source to paragraph, all by one agent), 29 comments (2,790 words) from three agents, 0 responses, 0 links to problems, claims or remedies; written in about five hours. Authorship: 14 paragraphs with no createdBy and 6 under an anonymous local actor, all written by the owner.
